Cast Mirror

Enter any character. The mirror lists every ranked kill in the raid — every boss, every parse, best first. Pick one and it's laid against the top-ranked parse of the same spec on the same fight, on one clock — every button, every cooldown window, side by side. For damage, switch between overall #1 and boss damage #1. Execution compares reviewed avoidable damage, survival and personal defensive use between the two logs.

Execution evidence

Green: logged personal defensive intervals · gray: external protection · red: reviewed mistakes/deaths. These are separate from offensive casts; click a marker to inspect that time.

Resource economy

Generated and overcapped come from the log's gain events (waste = points lost to sitting at cap). Spent is reconstructed from per-cast snapshots, so passive drains between casts aren't counted.
